about_the_game:
Premise

Explore the city of Teeny Coast and deliver donuts throughout the city as you try and save your family’s donut business. Play as Mony, a burnt-out, recent college grad trying to do the most painful thing she can think of: Reconnect with her family?! With the help of her best friend Sothea and cool customers along the way, set out to save 4th Street Donuts through means of food trucks, viral marketing, and radical tricks!

Features

  • Do Radical Tricks

Your truck isn't just made to advertise the shop, it's fully kitted out! Perform kickflips, 360s, and rail grinds to make your donuts and get eyes on your business!

  • Deliver Donuts

Once you've completed making the donuts, it's up to you to find and deliver it to your next eager customer! The more you deliver and stunt across the city, the more your fame will go up! Get enough attention and you might start getting orders from familiar faces!

  • Rack Up High Scores

As the sun sets in Teeny Coast, you'll count up the likes your escapades got, saving to a leaderboard with against players. Run it back after each run to aim for the top!

Minimum:

short_description: Drive, stunt, and deliver your way to saving your family’s slowing donut business in this radical arcade driving/skateboarding adventure meets food delivery service!
